category_battlegrounds.title: The Fractional OBP Decimal War
category_battlegrounds.dynamic: Will's disciplined high-contact approach (.3306) perpetually clashes with Garrett's all-or-nothing power (.3287) and Adrian's balanced lineup (.3312). These managers are perpetually separated by less than .002 in team OBP, meaning a single 0-for-4 slump or a 3-walk Sunday night trades 1.0 to 2.0 roto points back and forth between them.

category_battlegrounds.title: The High-Leverage Bullpen Arms Race
category_battlegrounds.dynamic: Preston's relief pitching monopoly (hoarding 6+ closers and setup men) is in a constant dogfight with Will (anchored by Josh Hader) and Tim's veteran bullpen. With Preston and Tim frequently deadlocked on saves and holds, every blown save or 8th-inning hold creates a direct 1-point swing at the top of the standings.

category_battlegrounds.title: The Stolen Base Turf War
category_battlegrounds.dynamic: Anil sets the gold standard for speed behind Bobby Witt Jr., while Dan relentlessly streams pinch-runners and speed demons off the wire to close the gap. Will grinds out stolen bases in high-efficiency spots. Single steals frequently flip 7th vs 8th place points in the final hours of a week.

category_battlegrounds.title: Pitching Volume vs Ratio Tightrope
category_battlegrounds.dynamic: Adrian protects fragile ratios with premium aces, while Dan streams high volumes of starting pitchers to accumulate Strikeouts and Quality Starts at the risk of ERA damage. Every 5-run implosion from a streamer or 8-inning shutout from an ace swings both ratio categories simultaneously.

category_battlegrounds.title: The Heavyweight Slugging Clash
category_battlegrounds.dynamic: Garrett's lineup of pure power hitters battles Preston's Aaron Judge-driven attack and Mark's second-half sluggers. Multi-homer games create instant multi-point swings in the standings, making power the most volatile offensive battleground.

season_trends_and_patterns.description: Teams ranked 3rd through 7th in the roto standings are chronically clustered within 2 to 4 total points of each other. A single category win or decimal lead flip on Sunday night regularly rearranges 3 or 4 standings positions simultaneously.

Rate categories (OBP, ERA, WHIP) and razor-thin counting stats (SB, SV+HD) experience dramatic swings during the Sunday night slate. Managers often wake up Monday morning to find their roto points flipped by a 9th-inning walk or stray hold.

As MLB starters fatigue in July and August, team ERAs climb across the league. Managers with deep bullpens and innings management suddenly gain massive ratio ground over teams running tired workhorses.

High-transaction managers (like Dan) routinely gain counting stat points in Strikeouts and Quality Starts through heavy streaming, but battle a constant trade-off where one bad outing erodes hard-earned WHIP and ERA points.

season_trends_and_patterns.pattern: Second-Half Surges vs Fast April Starters
season_trends_and_patterns.description: The league historically features managers who jump out to commanding spring leads (Anil, Adrian) who must constantly defend their cushion against second-half hot streaks from surging managers like Mark and Alex.

in_season_rivalries.name: The Decimal Dogfight: Will vs Garrett
in_season_rivalries.narrative: A battle of opposing offensive philosophies. Will obsesses over plate discipline, walk rates, and fractional OBP margins, while Garrett trusts raw slugging and home run power. They are chronically separated by hundredths of an OBP point and trade roto points back and forth all season long.

in_season_rivalries.name: The Pitching Philosophy War: Adrian vs Preston
in_season_rivalries.narrative: Adrian's starting rotation aces clash directly with Preston's radical relief pitching monopoly. Adrian attacks Strikeouts, Quality Starts, and pristine ratios; Preston sweeps SV+HD and minimizes innings risk. A weekly referendum on starter consistency vs bullpen leverage.

in_season_rivalries.name: The Wire Churn vs Draft Floor: Dan vs Tim
in_season_rivalries.narrative: Dan's frenetic waiver streaming and high-volume churn meets Tim's stoic patience and veteran consistency. Dan tries to manufacture points through 2 AM adds; Tim grinds out category points through deep, steady workhorses.

in_season_rivalries.name: The Summer Momentum Race: Mark vs Alex
in_season_rivalries.narrative: Two managers whose seasons are defined by explosive scoring momentum. Alex catches lightning with young breakout prospects; Mark mounts terrifying second-half roto surges that relentlessly climb the standings leaderboard.
